Record Class SortingColumn

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.hardwood.metadata.SortingColumn
Record Components:
columnPath - the leaf column's dotted path as the schema spells it, synthetic list.element and key_value.key segments included
descending - whether the column sorts from greatest to least
nullOrder - where the column's nulls sort
public record SortingColumn(String columnPath, boolean descending, SortingColumn.NullOrder nullOrder) extends Record

One column of the order a row group's rows are sorted in: the column, its direction, and where its nulls go.

A row group's sorting columns order its rows lexicographically: by the first column, rows equal there by the second, and so on. A column's values compare in its column order, the order its statistics use: signed or unsigned by its annotation, a DECIMAL by the number it holds, a STRING byte by byte. A floating-point NaN sorts after every number, and -0.0 equals 0.0.

Build one through ascending(String, SortingColumn.NullOrder) or descending.
